# CI workflows

There is no CI pipeline in this repository. That is deliberate.

This is gap **P1** in [GAPS.md](../../GAPS.md), and it makes a good Sprint 1
story: "As a developer, I want every push to run format, lint, typecheck, test
and build, so that a broken main branch is caught before review."

Participants who choose it in Lab 2C will need to author the workflow. A
reference implementation exists in the instructor notes, not in this repo, so
that the story stays real work.
